# Intern Final Talks 2026-08-26

Special lab meeting for the two summer interns' final talks, twenty minutes each plus questions. About fourteen people, including [[jonas-eriksen]]'s group.

## Talks

- [[noor-haddad]], "Filtering clonal hematopoiesis without buffy coat: a panel-of-normals prototype". Compared against matched buffy coat filtering on 40 St Aldric patients. It removed most CH variants but missed some private clones in DNMT3A and TET2. [[hannah-lindqvist]] cautioned that the 40 patients were chosen for having both data types and may not be representative.
- [[kofi-mensah]], "When spots run dry: simulating low-count Visium HD spots". Showed two deconvolution methods drifting to the dominant cell type as counts fall, matching [[kenji-mori]]'s observations on real data.

## Discussion

[[dmitri-halvorsen]] asked what false-positive MRD rate would be acceptable before dropping buffy coat; nobody could answer yet, which is why the buffy coat question stays open in the [[clonal-hematopoiesis-filter]] Project. Ines asked Kofi to write his simulator up as a supplementary section for the [[deconvolution-benchmark]].
